queries:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT u.acctscope AS acctscope, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM riskandmargin r
  JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
)
SELECT acctscope,
       cnt AS record_count,
       cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share_of_total,
       cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM counts) AS ratio_to_mean
FROM counts;
SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM (SELECT u.acctscope, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope);
SELECT s.scope, COUNT(o.orderspivot) AS order_count
FROM (SELECT 'Margin' AS scope UNION ALL SELECT 'Spot' UNION ALL SELECT 'Options' UNION ALL SELECT 'Futures') s
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.acctscope = s.scope
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
GROUP BY s.scope;
SELECT acctscope, record_count, AVG(record_count) OVER () AS avg_record_count
FROM (
  SELECT u.acctscope AS acctscope, COUNT(r.riskandmarginpivot) AS record_count
  FROM users u
  LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  LEFT JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY u.acctscope
);
SELECT acctscope,
       COUNT(*) AS user_count,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT acctscope) FROM users)) AS ratio_to_average
FROM users
GROUP BY acctscope;
